sepa-remittance-created: Remittance created. Download the XML file and submit it to your bank.
sepa-reference-help: Unique per mandate (max. 35 characters). Generated automatically if left empty.
sepa-iban-new-help: Type the IBAN here to set or change it; it is only ever shown masked.
sepa-creditor-id-help: Assigned by your bank, e.g. ES98ZZZ12345678A.
sepa-lead-times-help: Business days between submission to the bank and collection. Current SEPA rules allow 1 day in all cases; 5 is used for the first debit as a cautious default, check with your bank.
sepa-remittance-cancelled: Remittance cancelled; its receipts are available again.
sepa-cannot-cancel: Only a remittance with no recorded collections or returns can be cancelled.
sepa-mandate-legal-core: By signing this mandate form, you authorise (A) the creditor to send instructions to your bank to debit your account and (B) your bank to debit your account in accordance with the instructions from the creditor. As part of your rights, you are entitled to a refund from your bank under the terms and conditions of your agreement with your bank. A refund must be claimed within 8 weeks starting from the date on which your account was debited. Your rights are explained in a statement that you can obtain from your bank.
sepa-mandate-legal-b2b: By signing this mandate form, you authorise (A) the creditor to send instructions to your bank to debit your account and (B) your bank to debit your account in accordance with the instructions from the creditor. This mandate is only intended for business-to-business transactions. You are not entitled to a refund from your bank after your account has been debited, but you are entitled to request your bank not to debit your account up until the day on which the payment is due. You must inform your bank of this authorisation.
sepa-module-inactive: The direct debit (SEPA) module is not active in your plan.
sepa-line-already-resolved: This remittance receipt is already resolved and cannot be changed.
sepa-mixed-companies: The selected receipts belong to different companies.
sepa-receipt-not-collectable: Receipt cannot be remitted (paid, zero amount or currency other than EUR)
sepa-receipt-already-remitted: Receipt already included in another remittance
sepa-no-active-mandate: The customer has no active mandate
sepa-receipt-not-found: A selected receipt does not exist
sepa-save-error: The remittance could not be saved; nothing was changed.
sepa-no-operations: There are no receipts to remit.
creditor-missing: The company's SEPA creditor data is missing (Direct debit collection → SEPA creditor).
creditor-id-invalid: The creditor identifier (ACI) is missing or invalid.
creditor-id-check-digit: The creditor identifier check digit looks wrong; check it with your bank.
creditor-iban-invalid: The creditor's IBAN is missing or invalid.
mandate-date-invalid: The mandate signature date is invalid or in the future
mandate-reference-duplicated: Another mandate already has that reference.
collection-date-not-business-day: The collection date is not a business day
collection-date-too-early: Collection date earlier than the minimum lead time; first possible date
xml-not-well-formed: The generated XML is not well formed.
missing-group-header: Group header missing in the XML.
nboftxs-mismatch: The number of transactions in the XML does not match.
ctrlsum-mismatch: The XML control sum does not match.
amount-format: Wrong amount format in the XML.
pmtinf-order: Wrong element order in the XML.
invalid-iban: The IBAN is not valid (check the check digits).
invalid-mandate-data: Invalid mandate scheme, sequence or status.
